Nike and Formula 1 have signed a long-term global partnership that makes the Swoosh an official F1 partner from the 2027 season, with a remit that runs from event uniforms to fan-facing sportswear. Neither company has put a number on the term, but the scope is clearly mapped, covering F1’s own staff, the all-female F1 ACADEMY series, fan collections and new race-weekend experiences.

The most direct piece of the agreement puts Nike in charge of dressing Formula 1 itself, with the brand named official apparel and uniform provider for F1 personnel at races around the world. The announcement makes no mention of individual teams or drivers, so this layer of the deal centers on the people working behind the scenes at each race weekend rather than the cars on the grid.

items.title: The Patek Philippe Watch That Rewrote Split-Seconds History Heads to Sotheby’s Zürich Exhibition
items.summary:
Summary 

Sotheby’s ‘The Human Touch’ spotlights Patek Philippe’s Reference 1563 “The Doctor” in Zürich.The 1943 watch is the earliest known water-resistant split-seconds wristwatch.Once owned by Jean-Claude Biver, it’s the only example with a pulsation dial.

Revealed as a centerpiece within Sotheby’s The Human Touch exhibition , the Patek Philippe Reference 1563, also known as “The Doctor,” stands as the earliest known water-resistant split-seconds wristwatch in horological history.

The timepiece started life as a Reference 1436 split-seconds chronograph, movement number 862,420. That year, at the request of its first owner, Patek Philippe rehoused it in a 34.8mm water-resistant screw-back case by Taubert & Fils, the firm that took over François Borgel’s case-making business and kept its “FB” hallmark. The case is based on the Reference 1463 but made taller to fit the split-seconds movement, and it came with a two-tone pulsation dial, a scale used to measure a patient’s heart rate. The converted watch received a new case number, 630,552, and its case is stamped “Key 11” and “FB.”

Only three examples of the Reference 1563 appear in Patek Philippe’s archives, and just two have the dedicated Taubert & Borgel case. Their case numbers are consecutive: 630,551, fitted in 1946 to the watch later owned by Duke Ellington, and 630,552, this one, fitted three years earlier. That makes “The Doctor” the oldest of the three, and the only one with a pulsation dial.

The reference was unknown to the public until Ellington’s watch came up at Antiquorum in 1998, prompting Patek Philippe…
items.t: The Patek Philippe Watch That Rewrote Split-Seconds History Heads to Sotheby’s Zürich Exhibition

We're linking up with ODITI to help F1 fans take home a piece of the Las Vegas Grand Prix . The London-based publisher has unveiled a limited-edition poster lineup with Hypebeast and Formula 1 to capture the occasion through the eyes of artists.

The collaboration, which spans five art prints, marks ODITI's reunion with the championship group. It follows the season-long run with the Cadillac Team, which premiered bespoke pieces every week, created by artists local to the host city, including Slawn , Opake , Rhymezlikedimez , Nychos and Vxmeee most recently.

The Hypebeast x F1 x ODITI range builds on the partnership with five all-new works fit for Las Vegas. Featuring the likes of Richard Nadler, Claudia Locurcio, Cesar Botta, Caitlin Flood-Molyneux, and Emans91, the collection ranges in style and mood — from a deep blue, up-close portrait of a driver locking in mid-ride, to the cartoonish cars in West Coast tones and vintage-inspired gestural compositions — detailing the intensity, speed, and energy that makes the weekend.

ODITI's on a mission to bring back the once-thriving sport and art love affair. “Our aim is to publish prints that will become cultural artefacts to our grandkids, in the same way Haring x Le Mans or Miro x FIFA is to us today,”…

items.title: Axel Arigato Invites You to Its Community Game Night
items.summary:
Axel Arigato has launched a new series titled Games We Play , which focuses on organizing community nights inspired by the time shared between people during game nights.

Set to travel around the world, the first session of pool takes place in New York, followed by bowling in Berlin and chess in Stockholm. United through music, each stop on the tour is accompanied by a limited run of ceramics created specifically for the series by Sydney-based ceramist Gus Fredericksen of Slow Burn.

The drops are an extension of his pre-existing work, exploring individuals around a ceramic table. “I love the whole atmosphere of old pool halls, the characters, the pub and everything that comes with it. Bowling and chess were a bit more of a challenge, as they were completely new territory for me,” he explains.

Each piece is hand-crafted from stoneware, making no two the same. “It’s all the tiny details that I’m really proud of. The snapback on the back of the baseball caps, the sideburns on the characters, the collars on the shirts and all the little chess pieces,” he says. Each city will have a set of five incense burners tailor-made for the game played at the community events and offers a playful take on incorporating the functioning incense stick into the holders.

The designs hold a familiar feeling reminiscent of active gameplay, whether in third spaces or within the home. “I like the idea of someone having one of my pieces sitting on a shelf or coffee table and people noticing all the little details. Then when they light an incense stick, it adds another layer to the whole thing,”…
items.t: Axel Arigato Invites You to Its Community Game Night

Providing a backdrop unlike any gym studio, the store overlooked the famously buzzing strip, allowing guests to take in the views while partaking in high-intensity fitness. ERCOLE Studio's FW26 Holy Water collection has landed. Featuring gothic, weathered pieces that build on the Los Angeles label’s detail-heavy approach, the line is a mashup of personal references from creative director Abigail Hercules, including Catholic motifs from her youth and Heceta Head Lighthouse on the Oregon coast. Pieces span studded Japanese denim, black corsets with sun-faded finishes, silver jewelry and graphic jersey. 

An independent label, ERCOLE Studio is run by Hercules and co-founder Charlie Giannetti, each of whom covers a different side of the business. Hercules leads creative direction with a background in fashion, styling and luxury retail, while Giannetti owns production, which takes place locally in Downtown, Los Angeles.

Each ERCOLE collection builds a cinematic world using vintage research, natural fabrics and detailed finishing techniques. For Holy Water , the inspiration is the contrast of the Oregon coast, where lush forests seemingly collide with ocean cliffs, an environment that led Hercules to ruminate on spirits, the unknown and a sense of presence. Since Quantum of Solace in 2008, Tom Ford has served as the official tailor to MI6, outfitting Daniel Craig in razor-sharp, ultra-fitted suits that defined the era. However, Pattinson enters the franchise with a massive LVMH trump card: he has been a marquee global ambassador for Dior since 2013. Now, with the visionary Jonathan Anderson at the helm as Creative Director in this new era (2025 and beyond), the stars have aligned for a radical, hyper-stylish overhaul of the cinematic super-spy.

Anderson is famous for blending traditional heritage tailoring with experimental volumes, technical pragmatism, and a touch of playful, subversive irreverence. If Pattinson brings his Dior contract into the 007 universe, it would mark a seismic shift from Tom Ford’s rigid traditionalism to Anderson’s avant-garde elegance.

By pulling straight from Jonathan Anderson's Dior Men vision and Pattinson's own real-world Dior moments, here are five quintessential James Bond archetypes that would redefine the cinematic super-spy:

The High-Stakes Meeting: The Sleek Tailored Suit 

The Look: No Bond wardrobe is complete without a striking, perfectly tailored suit for a high-stakes meeting in a sun-drenched, exotic locale. Here, Pattinson brings an effortless 007 presence to a sleek, classic grey Dior suit . Whether it’s a…
items.t: Licensed to Dress: Will Jonathan Anderson's Dior Re-Tailor James Bond?

items.title: Vintage Modern Reimagines Classic Muscle With the 840-HP Vintage Fastback
items.summary:
Summary 

Vintage Modern debuts the bespoke Vintage Fastback, pairing a handcrafted carbon-fiber body with a modern S650 chassis.Featuring a 486-horsepower V8, with an optional Whipple supercharger boosting output to 840 horsepower.Commissioned to order, pricing starts at $295,500 USD.

Atlanta-based luxury vehicle builder Vintage Modern has unveiled a new addition to its range with the all-new Vintage Fastback. Unveiled at the inaugural American edition of Retromobile New York, the vehicle introduces a bespoke, classic-inspired silhouette engineered atop a contemporary 2026-27 S650 platform.

Rather than restoring an old chassis, Vintage Modern handcrafts each Fastback from the ground up using modern underpinnings. Over 900 hours of craftsmanship go into each vehicle, pairing carbon-fiber body panels with billet-aluminum accents across the grille, door handles, and mirrors. A long hood with a functional scoop, sculpted side intakes, and full-width taillights give the coupe a wide, aggressive stance. Inside the cabin, it’s thoroughly modern, featuring digital screen, leather upholstery, and three distinct seat stitching patterns alongside an optional JL Audio sound system.

Under the hood lies a 5.0-liter V8, delivering 486 horsepower and 418 pound-feet of torque. Drivers seeking an even higher output can opt for a 3.0-liter Whipple supercharger that pushes performance to 840 horsepower and 615 pound-feet of torque on 93-octane fuel. The engine is mated to either a six-speed manual transmission with rev matching, or a 10-speed paddle-shifted automatic. Additional notable…
items.t: Vintage Modern Reimagines Classic Muscle With the 840-HP Vintage Fastback

items.title: 'Avengers: Doomsday' Receives PG-13 Rating With Unique "Bloody Images" Content Warning
items.summary:
Summary 

Marvel Studios' upcoming ensemble film 'Avengers: Doomsday' has officially been rated PG-13The rating includes a unique content warning for bloody images, marking a first for the 'Avengers' franchiseThe highly anticipated film will officially hit theaters in the Infinity Vision format on December 18

Marvel Studios ' highly anticipated Avengers: Doomsday has officially received its MPA rating. The massive ensemble film has been rated PG-13 for violence/action, bloody images, and language, signaling a noticeably darker, more visceral shift in tone for the Marvel Cinematic Universe .

According to the official Film Ratings database, the "bloody images" descriptor marks uncharted territory for the franchise, which has historically leaned on standard "sci-fi violence" for massive blockbusters like Avengers: Infinity War and Avengers: Endgame . The shift signals that Doctor Doom's (Robert Downey Jr.) multiversal rampage will bring a heavier, more brutal edge to the screen. With a plot centering on Doom using powerful figures like Franklin Richards, Wanda Maximoff, and Bruce Banner to forge a new reality from a collapsing multiverse, the unprecedented rating warns that the impending hero casualties will likely hit harder than ever.

As teased in early trailers, the villain is already inflicting serious damage, effortlessly blocking Thor's Stormbreaker axe and blasting the thunder god point-blank. Establishing a threat level that seemingly surpasses Thanos, the darker tone implies that the stakes for the remaining heroes are significantly higher—and potentially more…
items.t: 'Avengers: Doomsday' Receives PG-13 Rating With Unique "Bloody Images" Content Warning

items.title: NEON Drops Official Trailer for Luca Guadagnino's 'Artificial' Starring Andrew Garfield as Sam Altman
items.summary:
Summary 

NEON has unveiled the official trailer for 'Artificial', a new tech-focused drama directed by Luca GuadagninoThe film stars Andrew Garfield as OpenAI CEO Sam Altman and explores the company's internal battle for control over artificial intelligenceThe corporate satire is officially slated to open in theaters on Christmas Day

NEON has officially released the trailer for Artificial , a highly anticipated Silicon Valley drama directed by Luca Guadagnino . Starring Andrew Garfield as OpenAI CEO Sam Altman , the darkly comic film unpacks the extraordinary 2023 boardroom coup that briefly ousted the tech executive before an employee revolt and intense investor pressure engineered his unprecedented return just five days later.

Written by Simon Rich, the corporate satire examines the tense battle for control over artificial intelligence, highlighting the severe friction between OpenAI's original mission, its commercial ambitions, and the looming dangers of the technology itself. The film features a massive ensemble cast portraying the tech industry's most recognizable figures. Yura Borisov takes on the role of OpenAI co-founder and former chief scientist Ilya Sutskever, a central figure in Altman’s removal, while Monica Barbaro plays former executive Mira Murati. Cooper Hoffman stars as co-founder Greg Brockman, Ike Barinholtz appears as Elon Musk, and Mark Rylance portrays pioneering computer scientist Geoffrey Hinton, with Jason Schwartzman also joining the stacked roster.

Originally developed at Amazon MGM Studios before being acquired by NEON, the project…
items.t: NEON Drops Official Trailer for Luca Guadagnino's 'Artificial' Starring Andrew Garfield as Sam Altman

items.title: beabadoobee Shares Long-Teased Fan Favorite “No Punctuation” From Upcoming Album
items.summary:
Summary 

beabadoobee announced her fifth studio album, Bananas 4 Cats , arriving February 19, 2027.Lead single “No Punctuation” trades Pylon's rock edges for an intimate, breezy acoustic sound recorded in east London.Following a surprise live debut at London's O2 Arena, the track centers on themes of home and devotion.

beabadoobee has announced Bananas 4 Cats , her fifth studio album, on the same day as the release of its first single, “No Punctuation.”

The news comes less than two months after the release of her Pylon album, which reached the Top 10 on the Billboard 200 and became her second consecutive UK number 1. It also follows her first US and UK arena tours, which wrapped with sold-out shows at Madison Square Garden, The Kia Forum and London’s O2 Arena.

Bea frames the two records as different sides of the same person. Pylon was written and recorded on the road with a large cast of collaborators, while Bananas 4 Cats centres on the idea of home: it was made in her East London living room with only a friend, her partner and her cats for company. “I just needed to write an album like this after Pylon ,” she says. “It happened naturally, I got back home and felt inspired, and made another album.”

“No Punctuation” has near-mythical status among fans, who have traded snippets of it for more than four years. It only joined the setlist of "The Powerlines Tour" this week, and the O2 show ended with meowing over the sound system as the lights came up, a hint of what was coming. The finished song leans fully into Bea’s softer side. Acoustic guitar strums at an unhurried…
items.t: beabadoobee Shares Long-Teased Fan Favorite “No Punctuation” From Upcoming Album

items.title: IWC and Mercedes-AMG Petronas Light up the Las Vegas Grid
items.summary:
Summary 

IWC and Mercedes-AMG PETRONAS unveiled bespoke racing suits for the Las Vegas Grand Prix.Inspired by Ceralume ceramic, the gear mirrors the material's day-to-night aesthetic shift.Kimi Antonelli wears white for daylight, while George Russell wears blue for the dark.

Celebrating its longstanding partnership with the newly crowned nine-time Constructors’ Champion, Mercedes-AMG PETRONAS F1 Team , IWC has unveiled a bespoke set of racing suits ahead of the Las Vegas Grand Prix .

Designed for drivers George Russell and Kimi Antonelli , the custom gear translates the dual aesthetic of IWC’s Big Pilot's Watch Perpetual Calendar Ceralume directly onto the track. The Ceralume material, engineered to store light energy via Super-LumiNova pigments, shifts dramatically between day and night. To capture this transformation, the two drivers are hitting the Las Vegas Strip in contrasting colorways that mirror the material’s shifting states.

Kimi Antonelli’s suit arrives in a clean white finish, channeling the crisp, daylight expression of the ceramic characterized by subtle interplay across white and gray tones. Conversely, George Russell’s racing suit is finished in a striking blue hue, serving as a direct nod to the signature bluish glow Ceralume emits once darkness falls.

Blending their material innovation with high-octane motorsport apparel, the contrasting suits turn the Mercedes-AMG PETRONAS duo into a striking visual spectacle of light and dark under the neon glow of the Las Vegas skyline.

View this post on Instagram A post shared by Mercedes-AMG PETRONAS F1 Team…
items.t: IWC and Mercedes-AMG Petronas Light up the Las Vegas Grid

items.title: Erewhon Brings Its Viral Smoothies to NYC With Newly Opened The Tonic Bar Inside Kith Women
items.summary:
Summary 

Erewhon is officially opening its first public New York location dubbed The Tonic BarThe new space is housed within the Kith Women flagship store in the heart of SoHoTo celebrate the launch, the brand is debuting an exclusive 'Erewhon State of Mind Smoothie'

Erewhon has officially announced the opening of The Tonic Bar by Erewhon, marking its highly anticipated East Coast debut. Located in the heart of SoHo within the Kith Women Manhattan flagship, the new destination brings the Los Angeles -based organic grocer's signature wellness experience to New York City for the very first time.

Open to the public seven days a week, the standalone bar concept will offer a curated selection of organic menu items, including signature tonics, superfood smoothies, bowls, juices, cold-pressed shots, coffee, and ceremonial-grade matcha. The new location maintains the same uncompromising standards for ingredient sourcing and preparation that have become synonymous with the brand's Southern California outposts.

Commemorating the massive East Coast milestone, the location is introducing an exclusive Erewhon State of Mind Smoothie. The red-apple-inspired blend features organic cold-pressed apple juice, warming winter spices, goji berries, maca, creatine, and coconut cream. With this specific release, Erewhon is proudly supporting the Bowery Mission, a historic nonprofit offering care and healing for New Yorkers experiencing homelessness.

The Tonic Bar by Erewhon officially opens on November 20 as a walk-in destination at 644 Broadway.

Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: côte&ciel and Joe Chia’s “What We Carry” Collab Folds Cotton Into Fluid, Shape-Shifting Bags
items.summary:
Summary 

côte&ciel and Joe Chia launch the "What We Carry" capsule collection.Origami-folded cotton LINGGI convertible backpack and fluid ENDAU crossbody bag.Available globally today with prices ranging from $310 - $370 USD.

côte&ciel has teamed up with Malaysian minimalist designer Joe Chia on “What We Carry,” a two-piece bag capsule about how material and movement interact. Known for translating architectural geometry into ergonomic bags, côte&ciel meets Chia’s fluid, garment-focused tailoring in a project exploring both physical materiality and emotional weight.

As Joe Goodwin from côte&ciel's marketing team notes, the duo aimed to unpack "what we carry" - not just literally, but emotionally - acknowledging how past experiences shape the way individuals move through the world. By filtering the brand's sculptural archives through Chia’s apparel sensibilities, the partnership creates what Goodwin describes as a sense of "jamais vu": an aesthetic that feels simultaneously familiar and entirely unexpected.

Both bags are named after rivers in Malaysia, a nod to Joe Chia’s roots and the idea of flow. The LINGGI is a convertible backpack that also wears as a shoulder bag. Its crossed straps meet a soft, teardrop-shaped body that sags and fills out depending on its contents.

As for the ENDAU, it's a crossbody that can also go over one shoulder. A single strap tapers into a sculpted, drop-like body, and in the product shots it hangs almost like draped fabric. Both bags are made from black cotton with a crinkled, textured surface. They’re built with an origami-style folded…
items.t: côte&ciel × Joe Chia capsule collection "What We Carry"

items.title: ERL Launches the New Wall Street Loafer and Mule
items.summary:
Summary 

ERL has officially launched its new Wall Street Loafer and Mule silhouettes from 'The Void' collectionThe foundational footwear features polished full-grain cowhide leather and a stacked one-inch leather heelThe drop also includes three made-to-order faux skunk fur styles available exclusively in-store

ERL has officially announced the launch of its new Wall Street Loafer , available now. First introduced as part of the brand's Thirteenth Collection, titled The Void , the new footwear serves as an expression of careless luxury and a statement of power borrowed and reclaimed.

The Wall Street Loafer is cut from premium polished full-grain cowhide leather and rests securely on a sculpted leather outsole equipped with a stacked one-inch leather heel. The brand is also debuting a matching Mule silhouette. Both foundational styles are detailed with a debossed ERL logo at the side, lined entirely in natural full-grain leather, and feature an electric green lining discreetly concealed beneath the vamp.

Expanding the premium offering, the range includes three specialty made-to-order silhouettes crafted from faux skunk fur: the Vamp Boot Skunk, the Wall Street Skunk Mule, and The Cozy Skunk.

The Wall Street Loafer and Mule are available now in men's sizes 6 to 14 at ERL.STORE and the ERL Studio Store for $475 USD. The specialty faux skunk fur styles are available exclusively in-store and are made to order, with the Vamp Boot Skunk priced at $1,600 USD, the Wall Street Skunk Mule at $885 USD, and The Cozy Skunk at $1,200 USD.

Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: In a flap: how the butterfly became a symbol of gen Z resilience – and anxiety
items.summary:
The delicate insect has become fashion’s favourite motif again – but having represented sexuality in the 90s and the soul in Greco-Roman times, what does it say about youth culture today?

• Don’t get Fashion Statement delivered to your inbox? Sign up here

In the new Gucci campaign, Mariah Carey blows a goodbye kiss to 2026 in the most Mariahhhh way possible. Dressed in a fake fur coat and an azure dress, she enters a Christmas party to the twinkly sounds of All I Want For Christmas Is You. There are beautiful people, presents wrapped with Gucci string and butterflies, which have been associated with the popstar since her 1997 album, Butterfly, but have recently fluttered back to become a symbol of gen Z defiance and girlhood.

Carey serves as fairy godmother to the other “pop girlies” who have embraced the emblem, from PinkPantheress to Dua Lipa; Rachel Chinouriri to Marina and the Diamonds. At the Academy Museum gala in October, the singer Janelle Monáe looked as if she might take flight in a Robert Wun couture gown, with wide, yonic wings. Elsewhere, Tate McRae recently wore a black sequined butterfly bra and matching butterfly wing belt from lingerie wunderkind Ludovic de Saint Sernin. Both Swedish popstar Zara Larsson and her fans are championing glittery butterfly makeup motifs.
items.t: In a flap: how the butterfly became a symbol of gen Z resilience – and anxiety
